description: Search social media videos across both SGE curated videos and app backcatalog videos. Supports hybrid semantic search by query, OR direct lookup by appStoreId (exact match, much faster). Returns matching videos with creator, hook type, pacing, view stats, outlier rate, duration, and source. English videos by default; set language for other markets.

appStoreId.description: Filter by app store ID (exact match). When provided, bypasses text search and returns all videos linked to this app. Query becomes optional.

dateFrom.description: Filter videos posted on or after this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2025-01-01" or "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z")

dateTo.description: Filter videos posted on or before this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2025-12-31" or "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z")

language.description: Video language as ISO 639-1 code(s), comma-separated (default "en"). Use the user's language if they ask about a non-English market, or "any" for all languages. Videos with unknown language are always included.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (1-1000)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

query.description: The search query text (minimum 2 characters). Try hook types, visual styles, app names, or content themes.

name: search_videos

kind.description: Panel type; always "videos" for this tool.

source.description: The video the user asked to analyze; null for searches.

analysis.description: SGE’s structural breakdown of the video; null when the video has not been analyzed.

ctaPresent.description: Whether the video contains a call to action; null when unknown.

hookType.description: Kind of hook the video opens with, from SGE’s structural analysis.

pacing.description: Editing pace of the video, from SGE’s structural analysis.

shots.description: Shot-by-shot breakdown of the video, in order.

end.description: Shot end, in seconds from the beginning of the video.

line.description: Spoken line during the shot; null when it repeats the on-screen text.

role.description: What the shot does in the video’s structure (hook, demo, payoff…).

start.description: Shot start, in seconds from the beginning of the video.

textOverlay.description: On-screen text shown during the shot.

visual.description: Short description of what is on screen; null when it repeats the text or line.

caption.description: Caption of the analyzed video, shortened.

platform.description: Platform the analyzed video was posted on.

url.description: Link to the original post of the analyzed video.

total.description: Total number of matching videos, which can exceed the number returned in videos.

outlier.description: Outlier multiplier: the video’s views as a multiple of the posting account’s typical views.

platform.description: Platform the video was posted on (tiktok, instagram, youtube).

similarity.description: Similarity to the query or source video, as a percentage (0–100); null for non-similarity searches.

url.description: Link to the original post on the platform; null when none is known.
